PHP86-008.disposition: Qualified-static correction; no valid-language removal established; exact-pin historical class-scope crash unresolved.

PHP86-009.disposition: Parameter documentation metadata; comments remain trivia. Three precise ReflectionParameter PHPTs now associated.

PHP86-010.disposition: Accepted-deprecated forms need informative specification update; retain negative readonly alias and nondeprecated method/underscore-function controls.
PHP86-010.gateB: READY WITH BOUNDED LIMITATIONS: warning-only prose; permanent fixtures and broader case/context coverage required with implementation

PHP86-011.classification: Implementation change without language implications; broader optimization interactions unresolved
PHP86-011.disposition: Stateless caching does not authorize static inference. Passing new expressions to reference parameters is a confirmed runtime boundary, not a new structural rejection. array_map fallback controls retain PFA diagnostics.
PHP86-011.gateB: No blanket optimizer exclusion or new grammar rule

PHP86-012.classification: Excluded or unimplemented proposal; implemented runtime-only scope
PHP86-012.disposition: Newly reconciled direction-aware property RFC has selected-pin cache/VM effects only. Original 58 identities and ancestry limitations retained.

PHP86-013.disposition: OPEN: credible compiler/AST/optimizer queues, reentrant linking and source/test associations remain; current-index review progressed but not exhaustive component/reversion review.
PHP86-013.gateB: Blocks complete implementation and unisolated changes

PHP86-014.classification: Unresolved language discrepancy with compiler/VM defect evidence
PHP86-014.disposition: Ordinary/list TMP dimension-write opcode inconsistency reproduced; reference result remains VAR and mutates aliases. Neither success nor failure establishes intended syntax.

PHP86-015.classification: Unresolved language discrepancy: contextual compiler validation order
PHP86-015.disposition: Direct/imported/qualified printf differs from namespace fallback/dynamic calls. AND/OR versus ternary/coalesce and discarded declarations demonstrate phase-dependent checks. No intentional normative rule established.
PHP86-015.gateB: BLOCKED: universal traversal rule; no builtin-specific EBNF
